note: Template keys and English source text for outgoing patient SMS. Translations live in en.json, sw.json, fr.json, rn.json under the same keys, with the same {placeholders}. Drafted by Claude Code on 2026-10-03; awaiting review. No diagnosis, no prescribing, no dose advice.

reminder_appointment.purpose: Reminder sent before a clinic appointment. {date} is filled in by the engine.
reminder_appointment.en: Hello. Reminder from your health worker: you have an appointment at the health centre on {date}. Please come and bring your medicines. Thank you.

follow_up_after_visit.purpose: Follow-up message a few days after a CHW visit: asks how the patient is, whether they take their medicine, and invites a BP reading.
follow_up_after_visit.en: Hello, this is your health worker. How are you? Are you taking your medicine every day? If you have a blood pressure reading, please reply with it, for example 140/90.

sms_check.purpose: Weekly SMS check-in from the CHW (planner 'SMS' slot): asks for a BP reading, whether medicine was taken, and any symptoms.
sms_check.en: Hello, this is your weekly check from your health worker. Please reply with your blood pressure if you have it (for example 140/90), if you took your medicine, and how you feel.

quiz_reply_instruction.purpose: Line appended to every education question SMS.

report_received.purpose: Acknowledgement after an incoming patient SMS is processed.
report_received.en: Thank you. Your health worker has received your message.

danger_signs_seek_care.purpose: General safety message on stroke warning signs (FAST-style, WHO stroke warning signs). Approved-style general safety text, not individual advice; still needs physician sign-off.
danger_signs_seek_care.en: Important: if you have face drooping, a weak arm, trouble speaking, a sudden very bad headache or loss of sight, go to the health centre now and call your health worker.
